cells.quote:
Rater training results on JIGSAWS

Inter-rater reliability analysis was performed on 10 videos in the JIGSAWS dataset. Strong to very strong IRR was demonstrated on the JIGSAWS dataset between the two raters in both the OSATS (rho = 0.954, 95% CI [0.806, 0.990], p < 0.001) and M-GEARS (rho = 0.841, 95% CI [0.433, 0.963], p = 0.002) scoring systems.
cells.note: The study reports positive agreement between two trained raters, not a treatment-versus-control comparison; the contrast is coded as rater 1 versus rater 2.
